collectionunit.notes: The small sheltered Northwest Crater site with a diameter of only 70 m at the swamp surface and steep slopes rising some 25 m to the crater rim should give a much more local vegetation record.
collectionunit.location: Small water-filled depression on northwest side of the island

geochron.geochronnotes: The carbonates removed by pretreatment were collected and dated separately to assess the extent of any possible contamination.
From stratigraphic and pollen evidence, a reduction in the sedimentation rate or even still stands in accumulation could be expected within this zone

site.sitedescription: The slopes of Northwest Crater, which have not yet been revegetated, are dominated by bracken and introduced grasses with a variety of native and exotic herb species. A few planted tree and shrub species, particularly Casuarina stricta, Acacia melanoxylon R.Br., Eucalyptus ovata Labill., and E. viminalis Labill., are present on the rim of the crater.
